gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic reads modern and unfussy, with a big lowercase and curves that stay open. And Joystix brings the arcade attitude up top, widely tracked and a touch heavier in the stems, so the body can be left a little larger.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-samarita: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Samaritan, whose hefty lowercase leaves plenty of daylight inside every curve beneath the mild contrast of Joystix. Lines of it would flow easily.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-saurasht: Noto Sans Saurashtra reads clean and level, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase beside them. Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps that sans-serif quiet while Joystix, widely tracked and arcade-bold, does the shouting above it.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-sc: Modern and plain, Noto Sans SC sits low beneath the heading. Joystix is best at loud, widely spaced arcade display with a lightly sprung contrast, while Noto Sans SC does its best work in text with chalky curves that stop short of closing.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Clean is the mood Noto Sans Sharada sets, with bulky lowercase and open c forms below the heavier stems of Joystix. Noto Sans Sharada keeps the sans quiet and sturdy, so the arcade heading above gets all the attention.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Approachable and contemporary, Noto Sans Siddham offers a large central band and an s with far-hanging ends, set under the pen-like bowls of Joystix. Its generous body is the draw.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Joystix shouts in wide-tracked arcade capitals with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke. Noto Sans Sinhala is the counterweight, a thick, dark stripe of lowercase whose curve endings never crowd each other, so the page feels anchored.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Professional and contemporary, Noto Sans Soyombo has a sizable x-height and curves with wide, unclosed mouths. And Joystix, softly varied in stroke and bold with arcade flair, sits above it as the loud introduction.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-sundanes: Noto Sans Sundanese reads clean, with open-mouthed e crossbars and almost no gap between x-height and caps. Noto Sans Sundanese is the steady half of this pair, while Joystix, bold and widely tracked, supplies the arcade swagger.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Joystix is bold arcade display, widely tracked, with hairlines only somewhat lighter than its stems. Noto Sans Sunuwar is better at the quiet work, its curves leaving rope-bight daylight and its short ascenders keeping text approachable.
